statements.status_notes: The vulnerable InlineIdsOrClauseBuilder is only instantiated under Hibernate's opt-in inline multi-table bulk-id strategy; Rundeck never sets hibernate.hql.bulk_id_strategy, so H2/MySQL/PostgreSQL default to the temporary-table strategy and the inline builder is never reached. Rundeck also performs no HQL bulk UPDATE/DELETE on attacker-controlled string identifiers (GORM uses parameterized queries and DB-generated numeric IDs), so the second-order injection data flow is absent. No upstream fix exists (GHSA-2p5w-cvg5-gc5c lists no patched version) and the version is pinned transitively via Grails 7.1.1/GORM, so this is dispositioned by reachability.
